summary.question: Is there at least one feature whose association with the target survives multiple-testing correction and the minimum effect?
summary.action: keep the feature whose association clears the minimum effect; drop or defer the trivial ones

evidence.baseline: no-effect shuffle of the target at this n
evidence.falsifier: the association's interval falls at or below max(min_effect, the shuffle null band) — the feature would be indistinguishable from a shuffled target at n=50,000

provenance.exclusions: pairwise-complete rows per feature; exclude_from_profiling dropped
provenance.segments: weekday/weekend by pickup_datetime day of week

comparison.question: Did the ETL change the passenger_count distribution beyond sampling noise (train+val (post-split) vs canonical (pre-split))?
comparison.action: re-check the ETL transform on the shifted column before profiling or training on it

evidence.falsifier: the standardized shift's interval falls at or below the minimum effect and the label-shuffle null band at this n

provenance.exclusions: pairwise-complete rows per feature; exclude_from_profiling dropped
